title: Non-Functional Requirement
description: Schema for a non-functional requirement (NFR) documented by Agente01_ProductOwner

category.description: One of the 10 mandatory NFR categories

description.description: What quality attribute this NFR defines and why it matters

metric.description: Measurable threshold or criterion. Must be verifiable by QA. No vague qualifiers.
examples: API response time < 200ms at P95 under 100 concurrent users
Session tokens expire after 30 minutes of inactivity
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance verified by automated audit
All application logs in structured JSON format with correlation ID

verification_method.description: How this NFR will be verified

related_stories.description: User stories this NFR applies to — empty means applies to all
